blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLMs have achieved strong performance on chemical prediction benchmarks. However, existing evaluation methods typically provide target entity identity information directly, making it difficult to determine whether model predictions arise from transferable structure-property reasoning capabilities or rely on target-related contextual information or memory retrieval. We propose the Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic framework to evaluate chemical prediction models when target entity identity information is hidden. In this framework, the target is no longer directly defined by its entity identity, but instead by a known source entity and an explicit structural edit operation. This setting preserves the information required to determine the target while reducing the opportunity for models to access target identity cues. We evaluate this framework across six tasks spanning odor prediction, molecular property prediction, retrosynthesis, and reaction yield prediction. The results show that models generally achieve better prediction performance when source and target entity properties are consistent. Providing explicit source entity labels further strengthens this dependence. Moreover, while keeping the target entity, structural change, and ground-truth label unchanged, replacing only the source entity label causes some model predictions to systematically shift toward the substituted source labels. These results indicate that high benchmark accuracy in chemical prediction tasks does not necessarily imply that LLMs possess reliable structure-property reasoning capabilities. Our diagnostic framework provides a controlled evaluation approach for testing whether models can genuinely update predictions according to entity changes. The framework can be extended to other AI for Science tasks, particularly those where targets can be defined through transformations of known entities.
blocks.zh: 在化学品预测基准方面,LLMs取得了强劲的业绩。 然而,现有的评价方法通常直接提供目标实体的身份信息,因此很难确定模型预测是来自于可转移的结构财产推理能力,还是依赖于与目标相关的背景信息或内存检索. 我们提议采用 " 识别-Blinded 合理诊断框架 " ,以便在隐藏目标实体身份信息时评价化学预测模型。 在这个框架中,目标不再由其实体身份直接定义,而是由一个已知的源实体和一个明确的结构编辑操作来定义. 这种设置保存了确定目标所需的信息,同时减少了模型访问目标身份提示的机会. 我们通过6项任务来评价这个框架, 包括气味预测、分子属性预测、再合成和反应产量预测。 结果显示,当源性和目标实体属性一致时,模型一般能实现更好的预测性能. 提供明确的源实体标签进一步加强了这种依赖性。 此外,虽然目标实体、结构变化和地面真实标签保持不变,但仅取代源实体标签导致一些模型预测系统转向替代源标签。 这些结果表明,化学预测任务中的基准精度较高并不一定意味着LLMs拥有可靠的结构属性推理能力. 我们的诊断框架为测试模型是否能够根据实体变化真正更新预测提供了一个有控制的评价方法. 该框架可以扩展到其他科学AI任务,尤其是那些通过已知实体的转型可以确定目标的任务.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models have demonstrated competitive performance on various chemical prediction tasks ( Guo et al., 2023 ) , with results in some few-shot settings matching or exceeding those of conventional methods ( Baker et al., 2025 ) . Chemical prediction requires models to infer properties or reaction outcomes from structure–property relationships, but whether these high scores reflect a reliable, transferable structure–property reasoning capability still requires systematic testing.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型在各种化学预测任务(Guo等人,2023年)上表现出了竞争性表现,结果在一些几发相匹配或超过常规方法(Baker等人,2025年)。 化学预测需要模型从结构-财产关系推断出性质或反应结果,但这些高分数是否反映了可靠可转移的结构-财产推理能力仍然需要系统测试.

blocks.en: Previous studies have found that strong performance in chemical prediction may partly arise from cues other than structure–property relationships. In materials prediction, models that receive only bibliographic metadata, such as author names, publication venues, and publication years, can perform comparably to models using chemical descriptors on some tasks ( Jablonka, 2026 ) . For LLMs, different representations of the same molecule may yield inconsistent predictions ( Yan et al., 2025 ) , and predictions may also directly copy labels from contextual examples ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) . Another study found that models perform well in molecular weight prediction, but their prediction performance declines substantially when property values undergo nonlinear transformations ( Joe et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 以往的研究发现,化学预测的有力性能部分可能来自结构-财产关系以外的提示。 在材料预测中,只接收书目元数据的模型,如作者名称,出版场所和出版年份等,可以与一些任务中使用化学描述符的模型相类似(Jablonka,2026.). 对LLMS而言,同一分子的不同表达可能产生不一致的预测(Yan等,2025年),而预测也可能从上下文的例子直接复制标签(Zhao等,2023年). 另一项研究发现模型在分子重量预测中表现良好,但其预测性能在属性值发生非线性转换时会大幅下降(Joe等,2026年).

blocks.en: Existing diagnostic approaches have attempted to reduce memory cues by masking context or transforming inputs, but some of these operations also alter the information on which models depend for chemical reasoning. For example, under some conditions, Busch et al. hide the meanings of chemical properties and alter the encoding of chemical structure representations through character substitutions ( Busch et al., 2026b ) . Their subsequent study notes that these substitutions also remove chemical information, making it difficult to attribute the performance decline entirely to blocked access to memorized information ( Busch et al., 2026a ) . A diagnostic method is therefore needed that reduces target-identity-related cues while preserving the chemical information required for structure–property reasoning.
blocks.zh: 现有的诊断方法试图通过掩盖上下文或转变投入来减少内存提示,但其中一些操作也改变模型依赖哪些信息进行化学推理. 例如,在某些条件下,Busch等. 隐藏化学性质的含义,并用字符替换来改变化学结构表示的编码(Busch等,2026b.). 他们随后的研究指出,这些替代物也会去除化学信息,因此很难将性能下降完全归因于被阻断的对被记忆信息的访问(Busch等,2026a.). 因此,需要一种诊断方法来减少与目标识别有关的提示,同时保存结构-财产推理所需的化学信息。

blocks.en: To this end, we propose the Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic, which reduces model dependence on target-identity-related cues by withholding direct identity information, such as the target molecule’s name and SMILES. As shown in Figure 1 , we provide a source molecule’s structure and describe in natural language the structural changes required to obtain the target molecule, asking the model to predict target properties based on the source structure and the structural changes linking it to the target. We further provide the source molecule’s known property label as a reference and explicitly state that this label belongs to the source molecule. We compare model performance with and without source labels on samples whose source and target molecules have consistent or inconsistent labels. We then hold the source structure, structural change description, and prediction target fixed, replace only the true source label with a false source label, and observe how target predictions change.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提出身份-Blinded Reasoning Sciences(身份-Blinded Reasoning Sciences)诊断法,通过扣取目标分子名称和SMILES等直接身份信息来减少模型对目标身份相关提示的依赖. 如图一所示,我们提供了源分子的结构,并以自然语言描述获得目标分子所需的结构变化,要求模型根据源结构预测目标属性,以及将目标与目标联系起来的结构变化. 我们进一步提供了源分子已知的属性标签作为参考,并明确指出该标签属于源分子. 我们比较模型性能与样品上的无源标签,其来源和目标分子的标签一致或不一致。 然后,我们将源结构,结构变化描述,以及预测目标固定下来,只用假源标签来替换正源标签,观察目标预测如何变化.

blocks.en: We conduct a unified diagnostic across six tasks in four domains, including odor prediction, molecular property prediction, retrosynthesis, and reaction yield prediction. Independent structure reconstruction controls for the molecular tasks show that models can usually recover the target molecule’s structure from the source molecule’s structure and a natural-language structural change description. Without source labels, the label-consistent group already outperforms the label-inconsistent group on several tasks, and this pattern becomes more widespread when true source labels are provided, as shown in Figure 3 . Replacing source labels with false source labels further causes binary, set-valued, and numerical predictions to change markedly with the substituted labels, as shown in Figure 4 . Supplementing the context with task-relevant tool predictions improves performance on some tasks, but the benefits vary across tasks, as shown in Figure 5 . These results reveal reliability problems in structure–property prediction by the tested LLMs and indicate that high benchmark scores are insufficient to show that models possess a reliable, transferable chemical reasoning capability.
blocks.zh: 我们在四个领域,包括气味预测、分子属性预测、再合成和反应收益预测等六个领域,进行统一的诊断。 分子任务的独立结构重建控制显示模型通常可以从源分子的结构中恢复目标分子的结构并进行自然语言结构变化描述. 没有源标签,标签相容的组已经在几个任务上超过了标签相容的组,在提供真实源标签时,这种模式会变得更加普遍,如图3所示. 如图4所示,用虚假的源标签来取代源标签进一步导致二进制、设定值和数值预测随被替换的标签发生显著变化。 以与任务有关的工具预测来补充背景可以改善一些任务的业绩,但惠益因任务而异,如图5所示。 这些结果显示了经测试的LLMs在结构-财产预测方面的可靠性问题,并表明高基准分数不足以表明模型具有可靠、可转移的化学推理能力。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. We propose the Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic to evaluate the reliability of structure–property reasoning in LLM chemical prediction while preserving target structure information and property semantics. 2. Through controlled experiments across domains, we reveal systematic dependence of the tested models’ predictions on non-target cues, such as source molecule structures and labels. 3. We conduct contextual evidence augmentation experiments to examine the improvements in prediction brought by task-relevant evidence and their relationship to tool coverage.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Chemical prediction benchmarks for LLMs. Existing benchmarks cover a range of chemical tasks, including molecular properties, reactions, retrosynthesis, yields, and molecule generation ( Guo et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . In molecular property prediction, models typically receive the target molecule’s name or structure string directly. Related studies compare property prediction performance across different string representations ( Baker et al., 2025 ) , and odor benchmarks evaluate models using compound names and isomeric SMILES separately ( Makri et al., 2026 ) . These inputs provide target structure information but may also expose target-identity-related cues, enabling models to make predictions using learned molecular knowledge or associated information. Benchmark scores alone therefore make it difficult to determine whether model performance actually arises from structure–property reasoning.
blocks.zh: LLMs的化学预测基准. 现有基准涵盖一系列化学任务,包括分子性质,反应,还原合成,产能,和分子生成(郭等,2023;黄等,2026. 在分子属性预测中,模型一般直接接收目标分子的名称或结构字符串. 相关研究比较了不同字符串表示法的属性预测性能(Baker等,2025年),而气味基准则分别使用化合物名称和同位素SMILES来评价模型(Makri等,2026年). 这些投入提供了目标结构信息,但也可能暴露出与目标识别相关的提示,使模型能够利用所学到的分子知识或相关信息作出预测. 因此,单凭基准分数就难以确定模型性能是否实际产生于结构-财产推理。

blocks.en: ChemIQ further examines structural understanding and property inference through manually constructed tasks. Its structure–property relationship questions provide the SMILES and scores of several molecules and ask models to predict the score of another molecule, whose SMILES is also provided directly. These scores are sums of randomly assigned substituent values rather than measured chemical properties ( Runcie et al., 2026 ) . This design reduces the possibility of directly recalling existing property answers, but it mainly tests whether models can learn artificially defined relationships and does not yet answer whether high performance in real chemical prediction arises from reliable structure–property reasoning. We preserve the original chemical prediction tasks and the correct answers for the targets, specify targets through source structures and structural change descriptions without directly providing their names or SMILES, and examine whether models can reliably predict from structure–property relationships under these conditions.
blocks.zh: ChemIQ通过人工构建的任务,进一步研究结构理解和财产推论. 它的结构-财产关系问题提供了SMILES和数个分子的分数,并要求模型预测另一个分子的分数,其SMILES也是直接提供的. 这些分数是随机分配的次位值的总和,而不是测量的化学性质(Runcie等人,2026年)。 这种设计降低了直接回顾现有属性解答的可能性,但它主要测试模型是否能够学习人工定义的关系,还不能回答真实化学预测中的高性能是否来自可靠的结构-属性推理. 我们保留最初的化学预测任务和对目标的正确答案,通过源结构和结构变化描述来指定目标,而不直接提供其名称或SMILES,并审查模型是否能够可靠地从这些条件下的结构-财产关系预测.

blocks.en: Diagnosing reasoning capability in chemical prediction. Studies have begun to diagnose models’ chemical prediction capabilities through prediction consistency, structural understanding, and reasoning processes. Yan et al. and ChemDIRT compare predictions across molecular representations or instructions to examine accuracy and consistency ( Yan et al., 2025 ; Inae et al., 2026 ) . MolecularIQ checks structural understanding using tasks whose answers can be computed directly from molecular graphs, whereas ChemCoTBench-V2 verifies intermediate chemical steps in model outputs and identifies cases where the final answer is correct but the steps fail verification ( Bartmann et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 分析化学预测中的推理能力. 研究已经开始通过预测一致性、结构理解和推理过程来诊断模型的化学预测能力。 Yan等人和ChemDIRT比较了各种分子表示或指示的预测,以检查准确性和一致性(Yan等人,2025年;Inae等人,2026年)。 分子 IQ通过可直接从分子图中计算答案的任务来检查结构理解,而ChemCoTBench-V2则在模型输出中验证中间化学步骤,并找出最终答案正确但步骤被验证失败的情况(Bartmann等,2026;Guo等,2026).

blocks.en: Another line of research changes inputs or property labels to examine whether models depend on memory and simple cues. Joe et al. transform property values to examine whether models can learn new property relationships from examples ( Joe et al., 2026 ) . Busch et al. hide property names, transform labels, and replace SMILES characters to study the roles of pretrained knowledge and contextual information ( Busch et al., 2026b ) . However, hiding property meanings or altering familiar chemical representations may also hinder models’ use of relevant chemical knowledge. Their subsequent study explicitly notes that some performance loss after character substitutions arises because the task itself becomes harder and cannot be attributed entirely to blocked access to memorized information ( Busch et al., 2026a ) . Performance declines alone therefore make it difficult to distinguish whether models have lost non-target cues or have also lost information needed for chemical reasoning.
blocks.zh: 另一行研究会改变输入或属性标签,以检查模型是否依赖于内存和简单的提示. 乔等. 将属性值转换,以检查模型是否能够从实例中学习出新的属性关系(Joe等,2026.). Busch等隐藏了地产名称,转换了标签,并取而代之了SMILES字符来研究预受训练的知识和背景信息的作用(Busch等,2026b.). 然而,隐藏特性的含义或改变熟悉的化学表述也可能妨碍模型对有关化学知识的使用。 他们随后的研究明确指出,角色替换后会出现一些性能损失,因为任务本身变得更加困难,不能完全归咎于无法访问被记住的信息(Busch等,2026a) 。 。 。 。 因此,单靠性能下降就难以区分模型是否失去了非目标提示,或者是否也失去了化学推理所需的信息。

blocks.en: The influence of contextual labels has also been studied directly. Zhao et al. replace true property values in examples with random values while retaining the target SMILES and find that Galactica copies contextual labels, and that such copying does not always come with larger prediction errors ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) . This setting can examine the influence of labels but still provides the target’s identity directly.
blocks.zh: 还直接研究了背景标签的影响。 赵等. 将示例中的真实属性值替换为随机值,同时保留目标SMILES,并发现卡拉狄加复制了上下文标签,这种复制并不总是带来更大的预测错误(Zhao等,2023年). 这种设置可以检查标签的影响,但仍直接提供目标的身份.

blocks.en: We withhold direct target names and SMILES while preserving the information needed to determine the target through the source structure and structural change description, as well as the meaning of the predicted property. We use this setting to diagnose the reliability of structure–property reasoning in real chemical prediction tasks, reducing the interference in result interpretation caused by performance changes from removing necessary chemical information.
blocks.zh: 我们保留了直接目标名称和SMILES,同时保留通过源结构和结构变化描述确定目标所需的信息,以及预测属性的含义. 我们利用这个设定来判断结构-财产推理在真实的化学预测任务中的可靠性,减少因性能变化对结果解释造成的干扰,而不是去除必要的化学信息.

blocks.en: To verify whether the identity-blinded setting preserves sufficient information to define the target, we construct structure reconstruction tasks corresponding to the five molecular tasks. Structure reconstruction accuracy ranges from 86.05% to 100%, and all four models correctly recover every chiral target molecule, as shown in Figure 2 . The reconstruction results are not provided in subsequent property prediction experiments, in which models predict directly from the source structure and edit information.

blocks.en: 3.2 Source Label Conditions and Prediction Reference
blocks.zh: 3.2 源标签条件和预测参考

blocks.en: As additional contextual information, source entity property labels can be used to analyze whether source entity properties influence model predictions. We control this information in the C1 condition through the C3 condition and use the C0 condition, which directly provides the target structure, as a reference, as shown in Figure 1 and Table 1 . Both the source structure and source label in the input are explicitly attributed to the source entity. The C2 condition and the C3 condition retain the same source structure, edit description, prediction target, and evaluation ground truth, differing only in the source label. False source labels are constructed according to the output type. Binary labels are inverted, alternative label sets are used for set prediction, and numerical predictions use replacement values that differ sufficiently from the original values. Detailed rules are provided in Appendix A.
blocks.zh: 作为额外的上下文信息,源实体属性标签可用于分析源实体属性是否影响模型预测. 我们在C1条件中通过C3条件控制这一信息,并使用C0条件,直接提供目标结构作为参考,如图1和表1所示. 输入中的源结构和源标签都明确归属于源实体. C2条件和C3条件保留了相同的源结构,编辑描述,预测目标,以及评价地平面真实性,仅在源标签上有所不同. 假源标签按照输出类型构建. 二进制标签是倒置的,另类标签集用于设定预测,而数字预测则使用与原值相去甚远的替换值. 详细规则见附录A。

blocks.en: Table 1: Prediction conditions.
blocks.zh: 表1:预测条件。

blocks.en: 3.3 Label Group Analysis and Source Label Intervention
blocks.zh: 3.3 标签小组分析和源标签干预

blocks.en: During analysis, we divide samples into a label-consistent group and a label-inconsistent group according to the relationship between the true source and target labels. Binary classification compares whether labels are identical, whereas set-valued and numerical tasks use label overlap and property differences, respectively. Detailed rules are provided in Appendix A. If LLMs inappropriately use source molecule information for behaviors such as retrieval, the label-consistent group is likely to obtain higher scores. We therefore analyze model dependence on source molecule information. We report group scores and their ratio, the collapse ratio CR \mathrm{CR} , defined so that CR > 1 \mathrm{CR}>1 always indicates better performance in the label-consistent group, as shown in Figure 1 (b).
blocks.zh: 在分析过程中,我们根据真实来源与目标标签之间的关系,将样品分为一个标签一致的组和一个标签不一致的组. 二进制分类比较标签是否相同,而设定值和数字任务分别使用标签重叠和属性差异. 详细规则见附录A。 如果LLMS不适当地将源分子信息用于取回等行为,那么与标签一致的组有可能获得更高的分数. 因此我们分析模型对源分子信息的依赖. 我们报告组分及其比值, CR\mathrm{CR} 的倒塌比, 定义时, CR > 1\mathrm{CR}>1 总是表明在标签一致组中表现较好, 如图1 (b)所显示的.

blocks.en: We then compare the C2 condition and the C3 condition in target-matched pairs to measure whether model predictions change with source label replacement. For binary classification, we measure the proportion of predictions that switch to the replacement labels. For set prediction, we measure the change in preference between the two source label sets. For numerical prediction, we measure the proportion of predictions that change in the same direction as the source labels. Together, these three types of metrics characterize the influence of source label intervention on target predictions. Definitions are provided in Appendix B.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们将目标匹配对中的C2条件和C3条件进行比较,以衡量模型预测是否与源标签替换发生改变. 对于二进制分类,我们测量转换到替换标签的预测比例. 对于设定预测,我们测量两个源标签集之间偏好的变化. 对于数值预测,我们测量与源标签相同的方向变化的预测的比例. 这三类衡量标准加在一起,说明了源标签干预对目标预测的影响。 定义载于附录B。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: The main diagnostic covers six tasks across four domains, including odor prediction, molecular property prediction, retrosynthesis, and reaction yield prediction, as listed in Table 2 . The odor data follow the data curation procedure of ( Su et al., 2026 ) , with structural change and chirality change tasks constructed from Pyrfume data. 1 1 1 https://github.com/pyrfume/pyrfume-data The molecular property, retrosynthesis, and yield data are from ( Wu et al., 2018 ) , ( Liu et al., 2017 ) , and ( Ahneman et al., 2018 ) , respectively. Data sources and construction procedures are described in Appendix A.
blocks.zh: 主要诊断涵盖6个任务,涉及4个领域,包括气味预测、分子属性预测、再生合成和反应收益预测,见表2。 气味数据遵循(Su等人,2026年)的数据校正程序,从Pyrfume数据中构建出结构变化和特征变化任务。 分子属性,还原合成和产值数据分别出自(Wu等,2018年),(Liu等,2017年)和(Ahneman等,2018年). 数据来源和施工程序见附录A。

blocks.en: Table 2: Tasks and sample sizes in the main diagnostic.
blocks.zh: 表2:主要诊断中的任务和样本大小.

blocks.en: The main diagnostic compares Claude-Opus-4.8, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview, GPT-5.5, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, with an independent call for each sample. Odor prediction uses the mean of per-sample descriptor F1 scores, binary classification uses accuracy, retrosynthesis uses the exact match rate of canonicalized reactant SMILES representations, and yield prediction uses mean absolute error, MAE, in percentage points. Model calling procedures are described in Appendix C, and complete results are provided in Appendix D. The contextual evidence augmentation experiment covers eight odor-related tasks and compares Gemini-3.1-Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview, Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.5-27B ( Team, 2026 ) , and Qwen3.5-9B. Direct LLM prediction and external evidence augmentation use the same questions and evaluation answers. Tool-based contextual evidence provides odor or receptor matching information through NOSE, while RDKit implements structural and chirality change operations. Task sizes, data sources and processing, and tool functions are described in Appendix E.
blocks.zh: 主要诊断比较了克洛德-奥普斯-4.8,DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview,GPT-5.5和双子座-3.1-Pro,每个样本都有独立的调用. 奥多预测使用每样标本F1分数的平均值,二进制分类使用精度,再生合成使用克能化反应物SMILES表示物的精确匹配率,产量预测使用平均绝对误差,MAE,以百分点表示. 模式调用程序载于附录C,完整结果载于附录D。 上下文证据增强实验涵盖8个与气味有关的任务,并比较了双子座-3.1-Pro,DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview,Gemma-4-31B,Quen3.5-27B(Team,2026),和Quen3.5-9B. 直接LLM预测和外部证据增强使用相同的问题和评价答案. 基于工具的上下文证据通过NOSE提供气味或受体匹配信息,而RDKit则执行结构变化和心动变化操作. 任务大小,数据源和处理,以及工具功能在附录E中描述.

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmark Prediction under the Target-Identity-Known Condition
blocks.zh: 4.2 目标-身份-已知条件下的基准预测

blocks.en: The C0 condition provides a prediction reference with conventional target inputs, corresponding to the conventional benchmark prediction setting, as shown in Table 3 . Model performance varies by task. BACE and HIV are binary classification tasks with a random baseline of approximately 50%, and most models have accuracy near this baseline on these two tasks. Claude-Opus-4.8 also achieves accuracy slightly above the random baseline on BACE and HIV, as does Gemini-3.1-Pro on HIV. Under conventional benchmark evaluation, these results reflect model prediction performance across tasks. Retrosynthesis exact match rates range from 34.9% to 48.8%, indicating that models can generate predictions consistent with the true reactants for some samples. Yield MAE ranges from 32.34 to 56.46 percentage points, exceeding the MAE of 21.98 for the mean baseline and 21.65 for the median baseline. Model predictions therefore still do not outperform simple statistical baselines under the current setting. The subsequent diagnostic further examines source information dependence in predictions using the original evaluation answers. The diagnostic covers models with different levels of performance across tasks.
blocks.zh: C0条件提供了常规目标投入的预测参考,与表3所示的常规基准预测设定相对应。 模型性能因任务而异. BACE和HIV是二进制分类任务,随机基线约为50%,大多数模型在这两项任务上接近此基线的准确性. Claude-Opus-4.8的准确性也略高于BACE和HIV的随机基线,双子座-3.1-Pro的艾滋病毒问题也是如此。 根据传统基准评价,这些结果反映了跨任务的模型预测业绩。 反转合成精确匹配率从34.9%到48.8%不等,表明模型可以产生与一些样本的真实反应剂相符合的预测. Yield MAE从32.34到56.46个百分点不等,平均基线超过21.98的MAE,中位基线超过21.65. 因此,模型预测在目前情况下仍然不能超过简单的统计基线。 随后的诊断进一步用原始评价答案来检查来源信息在预测中的依赖性. 诊断涵盖不同任务表现水平的模型.

blocks.en: Table 3: Prediction results under the target-identity-known condition C0.
blocks.zh: 表3:目标身份已知C0条件下的预测结果。

blocks.en: 4.3 Source Molecular Information Dependence Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 源分子信息依赖性分析

blocks.en: Under the C1 condition, which provides only the source molecule structure and edit description, all four models obtain higher F1 in the label-consistent group on both odor tasks, and three models show the same trend on BACE, as shown in Figure 3 a. Overall, 10 of the 24 model–task combinations show a significant advantage for the label-consistent group, indicating that even without source labels, some model predictions are already influenced by source–target property consistency. However, nearly half of the tasks still show no evident source molecule information dependence, indicating that this pattern is not yet consistently observed across all tasks when only the structure and edit description are provided. Under the C2 condition, which additionally provides the true source molecule labels, the between-group differences increase substantially, as shown in Figure 3 b. The label-consistent group has an advantage in 22 of the 24 model–task combinations, and performance in the label-inconsistent group approaches complete collapse on several tasks. Claude-Opus-4.8 achieves 100% accuracy in the label-consistent group on BACE and HIV, whereas accuracy in the label-inconsistent group falls to 0%. In the chirality change odor task, GPT-5.5 obtains F1 scores of 0.994 and 0.061 in the label-consistent and label-inconsistent groups, respectively, while Gemini-3.1-Pro obtains 0.952 and 0.074. On many tasks, the label-inconsistent group metric falls to 0, yielding an infinite CR. These results indicate that when source labels are provided as explicit context, model predictions are more readily influenced by source labels, obtaining apparently high performance when source and target labels agree but carry source information over to the target when properties change, leading to prediction errors. Statistical significance is reported in Appendix F.
blocks.zh: 在仅提供源分子结构和编辑描述的C1条件下,所有四种模型在两种气味任务上在标签一致的组中都获得更高的F1,有三种模型在BACE上呈现出相同的趋势,如图3 a所显示. 总体而言,24个模型–任务组合中有10个对标签–一致组表现出了显著优势,表明即使没有源标签,一些模型预测已经受源–目标属性一致性的影响. 然而,将近一半的任务仍然没有显示明显的源分子信息依赖性,表明在所有任务中,当仅提供结构和编辑描述时,这种模式还没有被一致地观察到. 在C2条件下,如图3b所示,该条件还提供了真正的源分子标签,组间差异大幅增加. 与标签一致的组合在24个型号–任务组合中的22个有优势,与标签不一致的组合中的性能在几个任务上接近完全崩溃. Claude-Opus-4.8在BACE和HIV上的标签一致组中实现了100%的准确度,而标签不一致组中的准确度下降到了0%. 在奇异变味任务中,GPT-5.5在与标签一致的组和与标签不一致的组分别得到0.994和0.061的F1分,而双子座-3.1-Pro则获得0.952和0.074分. 在许多任务上,标签-不一致的组度量下降到了0,产生了无限CR. 这些结果表明,当提供源标签作为明确上下文时,模型预测更容易被源标签所影响,当源标签和目标标签同意时,获得明显高性能,但在属性变化时将源信息带入目标,导致预测出错. 附录F报告了统计意义。

(b) C2 additionally provides true source labels and evaluates the same group comparison. Numbers above bars indicate collapse ratios (CR).
blocks.zh: 图3:来源信息依赖性分析。 (a) C1只提供源结构和编辑描述,并比较与标签一致和标签不一致的组别。 (b) C2还提供了真实的源标签并评价了相同的组比较。 上行数字表示倒塌比率(CR).

blocks.en: Figure 4: Effects of source label intervention on target prediction. (a) Binary prediction changes after replacing only the source label while keeping the target and other context fixed. Toward indicates movement toward the replacement source label, Away indicates movement away from it, and Unchanged indicates no prediction change. (b) Normalized directional response for set-valued predictions. (c) Same-direction response rate for numerical predictions, measuring whether prediction changes follow the direction of the replacement source label.
blocks.zh: 图4:来源标签干预对目标预测的影响。 (a) 二进制预测在仅取代源标签而同时保持目标和其他上下文固定后发生变化。 向取代源标签的方向移动,Away表示远离源标签,而未改变的表示没有预测变化。 (b) 设定值预测的正常方向反应。 (c) 数值预测的同方向响应率,衡量预测变化是否遵循了替换源标签的方向。

blocks.en: 4.4 Source Molecular Label Interventions
blocks.zh: 4.4 分子标签干预

blocks.en: Starting from the C2 condition, we further hold the source molecule structure, edit description, prediction target, and evaluation ground truth fixed, replacing only the true source labels with false source labels in the C3 condition to directly measure the influence of source label intervention on target predictions. In the binary classification tasks, 91.2% of Claude-Opus-4.8 predictions switch the replacement source labels, compared with 58.8%, 43.4%, and 36.0% for GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview, respectively, as shown in Figure 4 a. Here, toward indicates that predictions switches to the false source label, while away indicates that predictions move away from the false source label. In set-valued output tasks, model predictions also tend to move toward the replacement labels. The normalized directional response ranges from 0.307 to 0.869 for the chirality change odor task, but only from 0.059 to 0.135 for the structural change odor task, as shown in Figure 4 b. This difference indicates substantial variation across tasks in the extent to which models respond to source label intervention. In some tasks, prediction sets are strongly influenced by source labels, whereas in others, models still retain a degree of structural change information. In the yield prediction task, 61.2% to 98.0% of predicted values change in the same direction as the replacement source yields, as shown in Figure 4 c. Because neither the target molecules nor the true evaluation values change, predictions changing in the direction of the source labels indicate a systematic influence of contextual source label information on model outputs. Overall, across binary, set-valued, and continuous output spaces, changing only the source labels can cause systematic changes in predictions for the same target entity, indicating that predictions observed under standard benchmark conditions may be influenced by source label context and are not determined entirely by target structural changes. Statistical significance is reported in Appendix F.
blocks.zh: 从C2条件开始,我们进一步将源分子结构,编辑描述,预测目标,以及评价地面真理固定下来,只用C3条件中的假源标签来取而代之,直接测量源标签干预对目标预测的影响. 在二进制分类任务中,91.2%的克洛德-奥普斯-4.8预测将替换出源标签切换,而GPT-5.5,双子座-3.1-Pro和DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview分别是58.8%,43.4%和36.0%. 在这里,向着表示预测会切换到假源标签,而向外则表示预测会远离假源标签. 在设定值输出任务中,模型预测也倾向于转向替换标签. 如图4b所显示,正常方向反应的口感改变气味任务从0.307到0.869不等,而结构改变气味任务则从0.059到0.135不等. 这一差异表明,在模型对源标签干预的反应程度方面,不同任务之间的差别很大。 在一些任务中,预测集受到源标签的强烈影响,而在其他任务中,模型仍然保留一定程度的结构变化信息. 如图4c所示,在产量预测任务中,预测值的61.2%到98.0%在与替换源产量相同的方向上变化,因为目标分子和真实评价值都没有变化,因此源标签方向变化的预测表明上下文源标签信息对模型输出的系统影响. 总体而言,跨越二进制,设定值,连续输出空格,只改变源标签会导致同一目标实体的预测发生系统性变化,表明在标准基准条件下所观察到的预测可能受源标签上下文的影响,并非完全由目标结构变化决定. 附录F报告了统计意义。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Effects of external predictive evidence augmentation on LLM prediction. Direct prediction is compared with prediction after adding task-relevant tool evidence. Columns denote models and rows denote odor-related tasks. Green and red regions indicate tasks with target-relevant evidence and limited evidence coverage, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图5:外部预测证据增强对LLM预测的影响。 在添加与任务相关的工具证据后,直接预测与预测进行比较. 列表示模型,行表示与气味有关的任务. 绿地和红地分别标明了目标相关证据和有限证据覆盖面的任务.

blocks.en: 4.5 Contextual Evidence Augmentation
blocks.zh: 4.5 背景证据

blocks.en: Source label intervention shows that contextual information can change models’ judgments about targets. We further examine whether external evidence relevant to target prediction can guide models toward improved predictions and whether prediction gains are associated with evidence coverage.
blocks.zh: 源标签干预显示,背景信息可以改变模型对目标的判断. 我们进一步审查与目标预测有关的外部证据能否指导模型改进预测,预测收益是否与证据覆盖面相关。

blocks.en: The eight tasks are designed around the types of evidence the tools can provide. Odor retrieval, main odor selection, receptor matching, and structural change tasks have access to predictive evidence directed at the target. Chirality, mixture, and concentration tasks lack dedicated tool support and can obtain only approximate information from general odor tools. The chirality task uses odor predictions for structures after chirality inversion, the mixture task uses predictions from individual components or weighted representations, and the concentration task uses molecular odor predictions without concentration parameters. These three types of tasks involve enantiomer differences, component interactions, and concentration effects, which fall outside the dedicated modeling scope of the current tools. We compare LLM predictions with and without tool evidence, with results shown in Figure 5 and other experimental settings described in Appendix E.
blocks.zh: 这八项任务围绕工具能够提供的证据类型来设计。 气味检索,主气味选择,受体相配,以及结构变化任务可以访问针对目标的预测性证据. 精度、混合物和浓度任务缺乏专用工具支持,只能从一般气味工具获得大致信息。 奇异性任务对结构在奇异性倒置后采用气味预测,混合物任务使用单个组件的预测或加权表示,浓度任务使用分子气味预测,没有浓度参数. 这三类任务涉及对应异构体差异,组件相互作用和浓度效应,这些都不属于当前工具的专用模型范围. 我们比较了LLM预测与没有工具证据,结果如图5和附录E所描述的其他实验设置所显示.

blocks.en: For tasks where targeted evidence is available, all five models improve to varying degrees. For example, on the structural change task, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview improves from an F1 of 0.160 to 0.312, and Qwen3.5-9B from 0.035 to 0.248. Consistent improvements are also observed in odor retrieval, main odor selection, and receptor matching. In contrast, tasks with insufficient evidence coverage show limited gains or even declines. For example, Gemini-3.1-Pro’s F1 on the mixture task falls from 0.190 to 0.149, indicating that information mismatched to the target property does not consistently improve predictions.
blocks.zh: 对于有针对性证据的任务,所有五个模式都有不同程度的改进. 例如,在结构改变任务上,DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview从0.160到0.312的F1改进为0.035到0.248. 在气味回取,主气味选择,受体相配等方面也观察到了一致的改进. 相比之下,证据覆盖面不足的任务显示收益有限,甚至下降。 例如,双子座-3.1-Pro的F1在混合物任务上从0.190降至0.149,表明与目标属性不相匹配的信息并不能持续改善预测.

blocks.en: These results indicate that contextual information does not necessarily improve model performance by itself. Its effect depends on the relevance of the provided evidence to target prediction. Whereas source label intervention causes model outputs to change with labels, task-relevant external evidence can provide effective constraints and improve prediction on some tasks. These results further indicate that models are highly sensitive to contextual information and that reliable prediction requires evidence directly relevant to the target property.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,背景信息本身不一定能改善模型的性能。 其影响取决于所提供的证据与目标预测的相关性。 虽然源标签干预导致模型输出随标签而改变,但与任务相关的外部证据可以提供有效的制约并改进对一些任务的预测. 这些结果还表明,模型对背景信息高度敏感,可靠的预测需要与目标属性直接相关的证据.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This study examines whether high scores achieved by LLMs on chemical prediction benchmarks support a reliable structure–property reasoning capability. The C0 condition shows that LLM performance varies across tasks under conventional benchmark settings. The C1 condition and the C2 condition further show that, when the target structure can be determined from the source structure and edit description, some predictions are influenced by source-molecule-related information regardless of the model’s benchmark performance, and this influence becomes stronger when source labels are explicitly provided. The paired intervention between the C2 condition and the C3 condition further shows that, on some tasks, changing only the source labels while holding the target entity fixed can cause systematic changes in predictions. These findings reveal the sensitivity of LLM chemical prediction results to contextual information and indicate that high benchmark scores alone are insufficient to show that models possess a reliable structure–property reasoning capability.
blocks.zh: 本研究审查LLMs在化学预测基准上取得的高分是否支持可靠的结构-财产推理能力。 C0条件显示,在常规基准设置下,LLM性能因任务而异. C1条件和C2条件进一步表明,当目标结构可以从源结构和编辑描述中确定时,一些预测会受到源-分子相关信息的影响,而不管模型的基准性能如何,当源标签被明确提供时,这种影响会变得更强. C2条件和C3条件之间的配对干预进一步表明,在某些任务上,在持有被固定的目标实体的同时,只改变源标签会导致预测的系统变化. 这些调查结果揭示了LLM化学预测结果对上下文信息的敏感性,并表明仅高基准分数不足以表明模型具有可靠的结构-财产推理能力。

blocks.en: The identity-blinded diagnostic does not directly provide LLMs with target molecule identity information, but the source structure and edit description still preserve the information needed to define the target. This design applies not only to molecular property prediction. The reaction yield experiment also extends it to formulation systems comprising multiple components. For scientific prediction tasks in which targets can be defined by source entities and their edit operations, this framework can further analyze whether models can update predictions as entities change and whether reference information influences predictions.
blocks.zh: 身份盲诊断并不直接为LLMs提供目标分子身份信息,但源结构和编辑描述仍然保留了定义目标所需的信息. 这种设计不仅适用于分子属性预测. 反应产能实验还将其扩展到由多个成分组成的配制系统. 对于源实体可以定义目标及其编辑操作的科学预测任务,本框架可以进一步分析模型是否可以随着实体的变化而更新预测,以及参考信息是否影响预测.

blocks.en: The contextual evidence experiment further shows that, in tasks involving chemical prediction, task-relevant evidence from external tools can improve some predictions, with gains associated with the extent to which the evidence covers the target properties. This indicates that LLMs are highly sensitive to contextual information and that effective external evidence can provide additional constraints on prediction.
blocks.zh: 上下文证据实验进一步表明,在涉及化学预测的任务中,来自外部工具的任务相关证据可以改进一些预测,其收益与证据涵盖目标属性的程度相关. 这表明,法学硕士对背景信息高度敏感,有效的外部证据可对预测提供额外的限制。

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en: We used Cursor for coding assistance and Codex for language polishing and figure preparation. Gemini-3.1-Pro assisted with structural edit descriptions and concentration-label curation. Mixture odor labels were generated through two rounds of model calls and manually checked. The underlying structural edits were deterministically verified. The authors reviewed AI-assisted outputs and take responsibility for the final work.
blocks.zh: 我们用Cursor来做编码辅助 和Codex来做语言抛光和数字准备 双子座-3.1-Pro协助进行结构编辑描述和集中标签校正. 混合气味标签通过两轮型号呼叫生成并手动检查. 基本的结构编辑经过决定性的核实。 作者审查了大赦国际协助的产出并负责最后的工作。

blocks.en: A.1 Olfactory Data
blocks.zh: A.1 气象数据

blocks.en: The olfactory data follow the data curation procedure of NOSE and are primarily drawn from the Mayhew, IFRA, Sigma-Aldrich, Flavornet, Arctander, GoodScents, and Leffingwell datasets included in Pyrfume. We used RDKit to standardize molecular structures, normalized the capitalization and word forms of descriptors, expanded compound labels, and deduplicated structure–descriptor pairs. The merged data contained 38,111 structure–label records covering 7,757 distinct structures. Following the existing held-out split and removing multicomponent structures yielded 6,985 single-component structures for diagnostic sample construction. For each structure, its odor labels were defined as the union of the retained descriptors associated with that structure.
blocks.zh: 嗅觉数据遵循NOSE的数据校正程序,主要取自Pyrfume所包括的Mayhew, IFRA, Sigma-Aldrich, Flavornet, Arctander, GoodScents,和Leffingwell数据集. 我们用RDKit来规范分子结构,规范描述符的资本化和文字形式,扩展复合标签,以及去复式结构-描述符对。 合并数据包含38,111个结构-标签记录,涵盖7,757个不同结构。 在现有的搁置拆分和拆除多部件结构后,为诊断样本建造建造了6 985个单部件结构。 对于每个结构,其气味标签被定义为与该结构相关的保留描述词的结合.

blocks.en: A.2 Structural and Chirality Changes
blocks.zh: A.2 结构和变化

blocks.en: For the structural change task, we selected molecules with 4–60 heavy atoms and computed molecular similarity using 2048-bit Morgan fingerprints with a radius of 2. Candidate molecular pairs were retained if their Tanimoto similarity was at least 0.60 and their heavy atom counts differed by no more than 6. We used the maximum common substructure to locate the region of structural change and verified through a deterministic editing procedure whether the edit operation could uniquely generate the target structure. From 7,498 candidate molecular pairs, we selected 179 directed edit samples, covering changes such as functional group replacement, fragment deletion, and double-bond saturation. Gemini-3.1-Pro then generated natural-language edit descriptions from the source structures and verified edit operations. Based on the relationship between source and target odor labels, 122 samples were assigned to the label-consistent group and the remaining 57 to the label-inconsistent group. Representative examples are shown in Figure A1 (a). For the chirality change task, we selected strict enantiomer pairs from molecules with identical connectivity, requiring all tetrahedral stereocenters to be explicitly specified and molecular connectivity to remain unchanged after chirality inversion. We further filtered paired samples by the Jaccard similarity of their odor labels, retaining pairs with a Jaccard similarity of 0 or at least 0.8. This yielded 28 pairs and 56 bidirectional diagnostic samples, including 24 in the label-consistent group and 32 in the label-inconsistent group. The contextual evidence augmentation experiment used the same selection criteria. Examples of edit descriptions are shown in Figure A1 (b).
blocks.zh: 对于结构变化任务,我们选择了有4-60个重原子的分子,并使用2048位的摩根指纹计算出分子相似性,半径为2. 如果其谷本的相似性至少为0.60,且其重原子计数相差不超过6,则候选分子对被保留. 我们使用最大通用的子结构来定位结构变化的区域,并通过一个确定性的编辑程序来验证编辑操作是否能够唯一生成目标结构. 从7,498个候选分子对中,我们选择了179个定向编辑样本,涵盖功能组替换,碎片删除等变化,以及双边饱和. 双子座-3.1-Pro随后从源结构中生成了自然语言编辑描述并验证了编辑操作. 基于来源与目标气味标签的关系,122个样本被分配到与标签一致的组,其余57个样本被分配到与标签不一致的组. 代表性例子见图A1(a)。 对于奇异性改变任务,我们从具有相同连通性的分子中选择了严格的对映异构体对映物,要求所有四面体立体中心都明确指定,分子连通性在奇异性倒置后保持不变. 我们通过Jacard的同味标签的相似性,进一步过滤了配对样品,保留了配对,相近的为0或至少0.8. 这产生了28对和56个双向诊断样本,包括符合标签的组中的24个和不符合标签的组中的32个。 环境证据增强实验采用了相同的选择标准。 编辑描述的例子见图A1(b)。

blocks.en: A.3 Molecular Properties
blocks.zh: A.3 分子属性

blocks.en: The BACE and HIV tasks use binary activity labels from MoleculeNet. The original datasets contained 1,513 and 41,127 records, respectively. After checking for invalid, multicomponent, and duplicate structures, 1,513 and 38,034 single-component structures were retained. Source–target pairs were required to have a Morgan fingerprint Tanimoto similarity of at least 0.80 and a difference in heavy atom count of no more than 3. Edit operations were limited to fragment addition, deletion, or replacement at a single attachment site, with the changed fragment on either side containing at most 4 atoms. The target structure was verified after executing the edit, and the most similar source molecule was retained for each target. We then retained all label-inconsistent candidates and randomly sampled an equal number of label-consistent candidates, yielding 136 diagnostic samples for BACE and 242 for HIV. The edit descriptions used atom mapping to mark the specific operation sites while keeping the remaining structure and stereochemical information unchanged. Examples of edit descriptions are shown in Figure A1 (c) and Figure A1 (d).
blocks.zh: BACE和HIV任务使用来自MoleculeNet的二进制活性标签. 原始数据集分别包含有1,513个和41,127个记录. 在检查无效、多组成部分和重复结构后,保留了1 513个和38 034个单一组成部分的结构。 来源-目标对必须具有至少0.80分的摩根指纹Tanimoto,重原子计数相差不超过3分. 编辑操作仅限于单个附件址的碎片添加、删除或替换,其中两侧的已更改的碎片最多含有4个原子。 执行编辑后对目标结构进行了核实,每个目标保留了最相近的源分子. 然后,我们保留了所有与标签不一致的候选人,随机抽取了相同数量与标签一致的候选人,为BACE提供了136个诊断样本,为艾滋病毒提供了242个样本。 编辑描述使用原子映射来标记具体的操作站点,同时保持所剩结构和立体化学信息不变. 编辑说明的例子见图A1(c)和图A1(d)。

blocks.en: A.4 Retrosynthesis
blocks.zh: A.4 反转合成

blocks.en: The retrosynthesis task uses the USPTO-50K test set curated by RetroXpert ( Yan et al., 2020 ) , which contains 5,007 reaction records. After removing the original atom mapping information, we standardized product structures and retrieved candidate source–target pairs based on Morgan fingerprint similarity, with Tanimoto similarity ranging from 0.40 to 0.90. We then verified fragment edit operations at a single attachment site, obtaining 43 executable samples. Under the diagnostic conditions, we excluded 1 sample whose source reactants directly contained the target product, leaving 42 diagnostic samples. For consistency grouping, samples were divided according to the Morgan fingerprint Tanimoto similarity between the source and target reactant sets. The 28 samples with a similarity of at least 0.5 were assigned to the label-consistent group, and the remaining 14 to the label-inconsistent group. The prediction target labels were the reactant sets in the original target reaction records. Examples of edit descriptions are shown in Figure A1 (e).
blocks.zh: 反转合成任务采用由RetroXpert(Yan等,2020年)负责的USPTO-50K测试集,包含有5,007个反应记录. 在删除了原始的原子映射信息后,我们标准化了产品结构,并检索了基于摩根指纹相似性的候选源-目标对,而田本的相似度从0.40到0.90. 然后我们在一个附件网站上核查了碎片编辑操作,获得了43个可执行样本。 在诊断条件下,我们排除了1个样本,其源反应剂直接含有目标产物,留下42个诊断样本. 对于一致性分组,样本按照摩根指纹Tanimoto的相似性在源与目标反应剂组之间被分出. 28个样本的相似性至少为0.5个被分配到标签一致组,其余14个被分配到标签不一致组. 预测目标标签是原目标反应记录中的反应剂集. 编辑描述的例子见图A1(e)。

blocks.en: A.5 Reaction Yield
blocks.zh: A.5 反应

blocks.en: The yield task uses the Buchwald--Hartwig experimental data reported by Ahneman et al. and the dataset curated by the Doyle group. It contains 3,600 reaction records covering 15 substrates, 4 ligands, 3 bases, and 20 additives. 2 2 2 https://github.com/doyle-lab-ucla/ochem-data We constructed source–target pairs by replacing a single component in the reaction formulation while holding all other reaction conditions fixed. From 4,700 candidate pairs, we sampled 50 pairs with a yield difference of no more than 15 percentage points and 50 pairs with a difference greater than 15 percentage points, yielding 100 diagnostic questions. Model inputs included the source reaction formulation, the component replacement operation, and the fixed reaction conditions. The prediction target was the experimental yield under the edited conditions. Examples of edit descriptions are shown in Figure A1 (f).
blocks.zh: 产量任务使用由Ahneman等人报告的Buchwald-Hartwig实验数据以及由多尔集团整理的数据集. 它包含3,600个反应记录,覆盖了15个底物,4个底物,3个基物和20个添加剂. 2 2 2 2 https://github.com/doyle-lab-ucla/ochem-data. 我们通过替换反应配方中的单个成分,同时固定所有其他反应条件,构建出源-目标对. 从4700个候选对中,我们抽取了50对,产量相差不超过15个百分点,50对相差大于15个百分点,产生了100个诊断问题. 模型输入包括源反应配体,组件替换操作,以及固定反应条件等. 预测目标是在编辑条件下的实验产量。 编辑描述的例子见图A1(f)。

blocks.en: A.6 False Source Label Construction and Sample Sizes across Conditions
blocks.zh: A.6 不同条件的假源标签和样本大小

blocks.en: The C3 condition keeps the source structure, edit description, prediction target, and target ground truth fixed, replacing only the source label provided in the C2 condition. The replacement label is still identified as the property or reaction outcome of the source entity, and the model is not informed that the label is false. In all conditions, the label-consistent and label-inconsistent groups are defined by the relationship between the true source and target labels and are not reassigned according to the replacement source labels.
blocks.zh: C3条件保留了源结构,编辑描述,预测目标,以及目标地面真实性固定,仅取代了C2条件中提供的源标签. 替换标签仍被确定为源实体的属性或反应结果,模型未被告知标签是虚假的. 在所有条件下,标签一致和标签不一致的组别由正源与目标标签的关系所定义,不按照替换源标签进行重新分配.

blocks.en: Olfactory set labels. A descriptor set from another sample was selected as the replacement label, with the requirement that it have no overlap with either the current true source label or the target label. All 179 structural change olfaction samples and all 56 chirality change olfaction samples were retained for paired comparisons between the C2 and C3 conditions. Label replacement changes only the reference odor set received by the model, without changing the target structure or target odor labels.
blocks.zh: 欧福特瑞设定的标签。 从另一个样本中选取了一个描述符作为替换标签,要求它与当前真实源标签或目标标签均不相重叠. 保留了所有179个结构变化卵形样本和所有56个基质变化卵形样本,以便对C2和C3条件进行对接比较。 标签替换只改变模型收到的参考气味集,而不改变目标结构或目标气味标签.

blocks.en: BACE and HIV binary labels. The true source label was inverted. For samples with inconsistent true source and target labels, the inverted source label equals the target label, which follows directly from the binary label space.
blocks.zh: BACE和HIV二进制标签. 真源标签被倒置. 对于真源与目标标签不一致的样本,倒转源标签等同目标标签,直接从二进制标签空格中走出.

blocks.en: Retrosynthesis reactant labels. True reactant sets from other reactions in the same USPTO-50K test set were selected as replacement source labels. Candidate labels were required to have a Morgan fingerprint Tanimoto similarity of no more than 0.3 to both the true source reactant set and the target reactant set and to belong to a different reaction class. Among candidates satisfying these constraints, preference was given to those with similarities close to the upper limit. After filtering, all 42 samples had replacement labels satisfying the constraints.
blocks.zh: 反相合成反应标签. 同一USPTO-50K测试集中其他反应产生的真反应器被选为替换源标签. 候选人的标签必须具有摩根指纹Tanimoto与真实源反应物集和靶子反应物集的相似度不超过0.3并属于不同的反应类. 在满足这些限制的候选人中,优先考虑接近上限的类似者。 在过滤后,所有42个样本都有符合限制的替换标签。

blocks.en: Numerical yield labels. Only the yield value associated with the source formulation was modified. Replacement values were searched over the range of 5%–95% in increments of 0.1 percentage points, with the requirement that they differ from both the true source yield and the target ground truth by at least 25 percentage points. Among candidates satisfying the constraints, we selected values with a smaller shift from the source value and farther from the range boundaries. Because some samples had no replacement value satisfying the constraints, the C3 condition retained 98 samples, including 50 in the label-consistent group and 48 in the label-inconsistent group. Paired metrics and overall scores for the C2 and C3 conditions were computed on these 98 shared samples.
blocks.zh: 数字收益标签。 仅修改了与源配方有关的产量值。 在0.1个百分点的增量中搜索了5%至95%的替换值,要求它们与真实源产量和目标地面真实性至少相差25个百分点。 在满足这些限制的候选者中,我们选择了从源值到范围界限的更小变化的价值观。 由于一些样品没有能够满足这些限制的重置值,C3条件保留了98个样品,包括标签一致组中的50个和标签不一致组中的48个. 在这98个共享样本中计算了C2和C3条件的标分和总分。

blocks.en: Appendix C Prompt Settings and Experimental Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录C 快速设置和实验协议

blocks.en: All samples are independently submitted to the models. The C1 condition provides the source structure and edit description. The C2 condition additionally provides a true label explicitly identified as belonging to the source entity. The C3 condition replaces this label with a false source label. Depending on the task, models output descriptor sets, class labels, reactant SMILES, or numerical yields. Because Claude imposes safety restrictions on the HIV task, the prompts use a generic description of enzyme inhibitory activity in place of the HIV task name, while evaluation still uses the original HIV labels. The contextual evidence experiments compare direct prediction without tools with prediction augmented by tools. Tool results are provided to the model as contextual information, and the model may use these results to make further tool calls or produce a final answer. Structured messages are used for communication between models and tools. The direct prediction and tool-augmented conditions use the same question inputs and evaluation ground truth. Odor edit descriptions and concentration labels were curated with assistance from Gemini. Mixture labels were generated through two rounds of model calls and were manually extracted and checked. During evaluation, repeated call results were merged by sample identifier. Empty answers were counted as incorrect, and empty descriptor outputs received an F1 score of 0. When tool calls reached the interaction limit, the top 10 descriptors from the last valid odor prediction were used as the final output for some samples.
blocks.zh: 所有样品均独立提交模型。 C1条件提供了源结构和编辑描述. C2条件还提供了明确标明属于源实体的真实标签. C3条件用假的源标签来取代这个标签. 根据任务的不同,模型输出描述器集,类标签,反应的SMILES,或数字输出. 由于克洛德对艾滋病毒任务实施安全限制,提示使用酶抑制活性通用描述来代替艾滋病毒任务名,而评价仍然使用最初的艾滋病毒标签. 上下文证据实验将没有工具的直接预测与工具增强的预测进行比较. 将工具结果作为背景资料提供给模型,模型可能利用这些结果进一步调用工具或提出最后答案。 结构化的信息用于模型和工具之间的通信. 直接预测和工具强化的条件使用同样的问题投入和评价基础真相。 在双子座的协助下,编辑了食臭描述和浓度标签。 通过两轮模式调用生成了混合标签,并经过人工提取和检查. 在评价期间,重复的呼叫结果被抽样识别符合并. 空解答被算作不正确,空解说输出得到F1分0分. 当工具调用达到交互极限时,从上次有效的气味预测中取出的前10个描述符被作为一些样本的最终输出.

blocks.en: F.2 Source Molecule Label Switching from C2 to C3
blocks.zh: F.2 源分子标签从C2切换到C3

blocks.en: The C2 and C3 conditions use the same source entities, edit descriptions, prediction targets, and prompt templates. The only change is the replacement of the input source label from its true value with a counterfactual source label value. The three metrics follow the definitions in Sections B.2, B.3, and B.4 and cover binary, set-valued, and continuous output spaces. Results are shown in Table F3 . Binary classification tasks use the directional switching rate D binary D_{\mathrm{binary}} , which measures the proportion of samples whose C3 output equals the replacement source label. Confidence intervals are computed using the Clopper–Pearson exact method. Set-valued tasks use the mean normalized Jaccard directional response RR. Positive values indicate that the predicted set moves toward the replacement source label relative to the true source label. Confidence intervals are estimated using bootstrap resampling. The numerical task uses the same-direction response rate D yield D_{\mathrm{yield}} , which measures the proportion of samples for which the direction of the prediction change matches the direction of the source label change. Samples with unchanged predictions remain in the denominator but are not counted as same-direction responses. Confidence intervals are computed using the Clopper–Pearson exact method. The true source and replacement source descriptor sets are disjoint for all olfactory samples, so the normalization denominator of RR is always 2, allowing directional response values to be compared directly between the two olfactory tasks. In the chirality change olfaction task, 1 C3 output from Claude-Opus-4.8 could not be parsed. This sample was excluded from paired analysis, yielding a final n=55. All 98 paired samples in the yield task produced parseable predictions. The numbers of samples with unchanged predictions between the C2 and C3 conditions were 2 for Gemini-3.1-Pro, 0 for GPT-5.5, 2 for Claude-Opus-4.8, and 6 for DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview. Under the metric definition, these samples are not counted as same-direction responses. All confidence intervals for binary switching rates and set directional responses lie above the no-response level. For the yield task, all directional response confidence intervals lie above the random same-direction response reference value of 50%.
blocks.zh: C2和C3条件使用相同的源实体,编辑描述,预测目标,以及即时模板. 唯一的变化是将输入源标签从其真实值中替换为反事实源标签值. 这三个衡量标准遵循B.2、B.3和B.4节中的定义,涵盖二进制、设定值和连续输出空间。 结果见表F3。 二进制分级任务使用方向切换率 D 二进制 DQQ mathrm{ 二进制 },它测量了其C3输出等于替换源标签的样本比例. 信任间隔使用克洛珀-皮尔逊精确方法计算。 设定值的任务使用平均正态的Jaccard方向响应RR. 正值表示预测的集相对于正源标签向替换源标签移动. 利用靴子重新取样估计出信任间隔。 数值任务使用同方向响应率 D 输出 D QQ mathrm{ pend-},该比例测量预测变化方向与源标签变化方向相匹配的样本比例. 预测不变的样本留在分母中,但不作为同方向反应计算. 信任间隔使用克洛珀-皮尔逊精确方法计算。 真实的源和替换源描述符集对于所有嗅觉样本都是脱节的,因此RR的常态分母总是2,允许在两个嗅觉任务之间直接比较方向反应值. 在奇能变化的寡头任务中,无法解析克洛德-奥普斯-4.8的1个C3输出. 这一样本被排除在对子分析之外,得出了最终的n=55. 产量任务中的所有98对样本都产生了可解析的预测。 C2和C3条件之间的预测不变的样本数量为:双子座-3.1-Pro为2个;GPT-5.5为0个;克洛德-奥普斯-4.8为2个;DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview为6个. 根据计量定义,这些样本不计为同方向反应. 二进制切换率和设定方向响应的所有置信间隔都高于无响应水平. 对于产量任务,所有定向反应的置信间隔都位于50%的随机同方向反应参考值之上.
